collections.name: Trace Art
collections.description:
Its characters begin in 3D, where their forms and traits are designed and assembled. Custom-built tools then transform them into ASCII portraits composed entirely of letters, numbers, and symbols.

You won’t see your character right away. Each artwork begins in an encoded form, using one of three methods to record the symbols that make up its portrait: Punched card, Base64, Binary.

The result is an abstract record of the portrait, without preserving the original arrangement of its symbols. Every stage stands on its own as a finished artwork. You can choose to keep it as it is or explore what comes next.

collections.name: Ape Hood
collections.description:
**Ape Hood** is a community-curated collection of Apes built for the culture. Born onchain, raised in the trenches, and now posted up on Robinhood..

We gave Apes a wardrobe and let the community take it from there. What started as an idea became a meta that helped kick open the door for fully customizable, evolving ERC721s. The wave spread across the blockchain, and plenty followed.

Now we’re bringing that same **Based Steez** to Robinhood.

Style your Ape however you want through our integrated Wardrobe. Fits change. Seasons change. Holidays hit. The Hood moves with it. Your Ape isn't stuck in one look, it's part of an evolving culture.

From the artist who put Ape holders in Christie's suits, Adidas tracksuits, Halloween fits and everything in between, **The Tailor** presents a project years in the making.

**Welcome to Ape Hood.**

Ape Hood is a derivative of Bored Ape Yacht Club and is in no way affiliated with or partnered with Yuga Labs or Bored Ape Yacht Club.

collections.name: Hopium Machines
collections.description:
6,969 machines that print pure hope. Trustless. Gasless. Worthless.

Every machine on this chain prints something — stocks, yield, airdrops. Ours print the only asset with infinite supply and infinite demand: hope. One promise per machine every 3.5 days (seven would be too honest), computed deterministically, redeemable for nothing. APY: 6,969%, measured in promises per year.

Exactly 38 raspberries. One machine - #4663 - came off the assembly line switched off. It prints nothing. It has transcended.

The facts: free mint, max 1 per wallet. The mint lives on OpenSea and nowhere else.

🖨 hopiummachines.xyz

collections.name: Clay StonKz
collections.description:
Clay StonKz is a collection of 6,969 clay characters inspired by markets, memes, crypto, stocks, bulls, bears, wins, losses, and the occasional rug pullz.

Every character and trait begins in the physical world. Brrrbon sculpt the clay by hand, photograph it, then bring those images into the digital world where they’re layered together to create the final collection.

Fingerprints, dents, uneven edges, mistakes, and texture are all part of the work. I’m not trying to make clay look digital. I’m trying to make the digital world look like it was made out of clay.

Real clay. Real photography.
Created physically. Collected digitally.

collections.name: HoodMiners
collections.description:
# What is HoodMiners?

HoodMiners is a 5,000-supply free-mint NFT collection on Robinhood Chain built around a simple idea: 
Hood Miners do not just sit in your wallet. They can earn and accumulate assets over time.

*Each Hood Miner is both a collectible and its own smart wallet.* 
Once activated, Miners can earn a share of rewards generated across the HoodMiners ecosystem.

Rewards are designed to include assets such as Bitcoin, with tokenized stocks, gold, and other digital assets potentially introduced in future reward epochs.

What makes the concept different is that these assets accumulate inside the Miner itself. If the NFT is sold, the Miner, its wallet, and the assets accumulated inside it move together to the new owner.
